detail: Tax Administration Law art. 32: 0.05% of overdue tax per day; underlying tax still due.
Arts. 63–64: specified conduct may attract 50%–500% of unpaid tax, plus surcharge; facts and criminal rules matter.
FX Regulations arts. 39, 40 and 45 have different elements and fine ranges; severe cases can trigger criminal liability. Do not presume a penalty applies.

31 CFR 1010.821 shows $16,536 nonwillful and $165,353 adjusted willful statutory dollar component for assessments on or after 2025-01-17; willful alternative 50% may apply; verify current adjustments and facts.
IRS streamlined procedures require certification of nonwillfulness and additional eligibility; not an automatic waiver. Seek qualified advice.
More than $10,000 transported into or out of U.S. must be reported; failure may result in seizure, forfeiture and penalties.
IIT law specifies 3%–45% comprehensive income, and 20% for specified categories. Tax base, exemptions and residency matter; this is not a tax on the wire itself.
China temporarily exempts eligible savings interest earned since 2008-10-09; home sale VAT depends on holding period and applicable rules. U.S. treatment is separate.
§988 applies to certain currency dispositions; the $200 personal-transaction exception has conditions. Basis and character are fact-dependent.
Qualifying foreign income tax may be credited subject to conditions and limitations; no credit for taxes on excluded income.
Foreign individual or estate gifts/bequests over $100,000 aggregate may require Form 3520; related-party aggregation and separate rules apply.
